The fear was never learned — it was inherited, sitting in the DNA before the child ever had a single experience of their own. Same story with flying, same mechanism. Two Italian parents died in a crash. Their baby was adopted and raised by a Japanese family, in Japan, speaking only Japanese, from day one.

That's not something you learn. Personality, temperament, even the shy kid versus the kid born wanting the spotlight — more of it than you think was already decided before you took your first breath.
